# AOL

> > AOL is a digital media platform featuring financial analysis, consumer advice, lifestyle content, and news coverage across investing, technology, and everyday life topics.

The site hosts a diverse range of content including investment analysis from The Motley Fool, consumer guides on telecommunications and unemployment benefits, real estate market analysis, and lifestyle articles covering food, travel, and human interest stories. AOL serves as a content aggregator and publisher spanning business, finance, and general interest categories.

## Key Topics

- The Motley Fool
- Stock Analysis
- Investment Analysis
- Quarterly Earnings
- Financial Metrics
- Cellphone Carriers (T-Mobile, Sprint, Verizon, AT&T)
- Business Wire
- Apollo Global Management
- S&P Capital IQ
- Carrier Switching
- Mobile Plans
- Real Estate Markets
- Consumer Advice
- Financial Results

## Financial Analysis & Stock Market

- [The Motley Fool's Weekly Editors' Picks](https://www.aol.com/2011/08/20/the-motley-fools-weekly-editors-picks): Motley Fool weekly roundup of investing advice and stock market analysis
- [The Cheapskate's Portfolio](https://www.aol.com/2011/11/02/the-cheapskates-portfolio): Low-cost ETF investment strategy featuring Vanguard S&P 500 and Mid-Cap
- [Sensient Technologies Passes This Key Test](https://www.aol.com/2012/04/05/sensient-technologies-passes-this-key-test): Sensient Technologies stock analysis focusing on accounts receivable health
- [Don't Get Too Worked Up Over Steinway Musical Instruments' Latest Numbers](https://www.aol.com/2012/05/29/dont-get-too-worked-up-over-steinway-musical-instr): Motley Fool analysis of Steinway Musical Instruments inventory levels
- [Capstone Turbine Earnings: An Early Look](https://www.aol.com/2013/02/08/capstone-turbine-earnings-an-early-look): Motley Fool preview of Capstone Turbine quarterly earnings expectations
- [Apollo Global Management, LLC Reports Financial Results for the Fourth Quarter and Year Ended December](https://www.aol.com/2013/02/08/apollo-global-management-llc-reports-financial-res): Apollo Global Management Q4 2012 earnings and distribution announcement

## Consumer Technology & Telecommunications

- [Should You Switch to a New Cellphone Carrier in 2014?](https://www.aol.com/2013/12/24/should-you-switch-to-a-new-cellphone-carrier-in-20): Comparison of T-Mobile, Sprint, Verizon carrier switching costs for 2014
- [Global Colocation Solutions Provider CyrusOne Launches Service Advantage Platform](https://www.aol.com/2013/04/18/global-colocation-solutions-provider-cyrusone-laun): CyrusOne launches self-service data center management platform
- [Internet Tips and Tricks to Help You Land Your Next Job](https://www.aol.com/2009/10/26/internet-tips-and-tricks-to-help-you-land-your-next-job): CareerBuilder job search tips and internet resources for job seekers

## Real Estate & Housing

- [South Florida Real Estate: Is It Finally Time to Buy?](https://www.aol.com/2010/09/22/south-florida-real-estate-is-it-finally-time-to-buy): Analysis of South Florida housing market recovery and investment timing
- [Detroit Mom Trades $96,000 House for Used Minivan](https://www.aol.com/2011/12/06/detroit-mom-trades-96-000-house-for-used-minivan): Detroit mom LaWanda Flake swaps Russell Woods home for minivan on Craigslist
- [Rigrodsky & Long, P.A. Announces Investigation Of Harris Teeter Supermarkets, Inc. Buyout](https://www.aol.com/2013/07/09/rigrodsky-long-pa-announces-investigation-of-harri): Legal investigation of Kroger's $49.38/share Harris Teeter buyout offer

## Lifestyle & Consumer Guides

- [Wisconsin Unemployment Guide](https://www.aol.com/2010/07/12/unemployment-wi): Guide to filing Wisconsin Unemployment Insurance benefits claims
- [Vegetarian Holiday Cooking Tips](https://www.aol.com/food/vegetarian-holiday-cooking-tips): Vegetarian Thanksgiving recipe recommendations and cooking tips
- [This Thanksgiving, Don't Forget to Thank Canada for Your Dinner](https://www.aol.com/2011/11/24/this-thanksgiving-dont-forget-to-thank-canada-for-your-dinner): Canadian food imports role in American Thanksgiving dinner traditions
- [Easy Cleaning Essentials](https://www.aol.com/2006/06/08/easy-cleaning-essentials): Home cleaning tips including professional services and carpet maintenance
- [Montreal Slang](https://www.aol.com/2010/10/11/montreal-slang): Guide to Montreal local slang and bilingual French-English culture
